zh: 全站改名 April's Stock Atlas，首页换成「AI 产业链：五层全景」，按层分页，并新增为 AI 建设提供资金的资本层
en: the site is now April's Stock Atlas, with "The AI supply chain in five layers" as the homepage, one tab per layer and a new Capital group of the banks and asset managers funding the AI buildout

zh: 每个页面都可以订阅周报
en: you can subscribe to this email from every page

zh: 财报解读和财报日历支持简体、繁体和英文
en: earnings reports and the earnings calendar are available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English

zh: 每份财报解读新增「未来几年的增长从哪来」、三情境估值和情景价格
en: every earnings report now covers where future growth comes from, with three valuation scenarios and scenario prices

zh: 网站新增期权异动、机构持仓（13F 和 13D）、宏观日历和每日盘后复盘，首页改成「今日信号」，所有页面用同一条导航
en: the site now has options activity, institutional holdings (13F and 13D), a macro calendar and a daily market recap; the homepage shows today's signals and every page shares one navigation bar
